observation: Extract-over-invent discipline converged the model: founder forced 'STOP we have this already' at 8 decision points (Kind→base-primitive, kinds-vs-blocks merge, data→3, Kind purity, Representation removal, SplitView extract, Hearth layering, unified split) and delivered a smaller, reusable, self-consistent final model verified to unify Artifact/Review/Block on canonical base primitives.

Collapse/purge/fold delivered real architectural purification: kinds/*-renderer.tsx layer (AE6) deleted (not refactored), KPI and Sparkline extracted as genuine new primitives from old data-renderer, diff-core separated from content (code→{path,text,lang} with no diff baked in), SplitView unified (3 divergent splits→1 canonical), verified inverse (Review builds diff from two pure-code instances, not stored). Landed correctly with one consumer-wiring fix only.

TDD red-phase + task-boundary commits enabled surgical code review: 9 clean Phase 3 commits (T1-T9), each test→code→bless progression, logical subsystem boundaries (primitives→schema-purge→arch-collapse→split-reconcile→routing-seams→cleanup-wiring). One review catch (T2 diff-core unwired) fixed in T9 rework with no cascade. Review was effective and finite (2 rounds).

Design-system foundation re-placement broke two-home bottleneck: moved diff-core and base primitives LOW (packages/design-system, not web-local kinds/*-renderer.tsx) enabled Review to import DS diff foundation and add only chrome (PR header, file bands, approve/reject), not re-implement. Made base-primitive vocabulary visible and reusable across boundaries. Three compositions now share canonical rendering family.

Model reshaped 8 times by founder iteration during pre-build (40% of branch weight): Kind vocab collapse, kinds-vs-blocks merge, data→3-split, Kind purity retract, Representation enum remove, SplitView extract, Hearth layering 3x iterate, per-composition→unified split. Root: concept not locked before Phase 2; design started with unlocked model and founder iterated in-flight across 20 commits. Human-design-review approval came very late (2026-06-26) AFTER 3 critique loops, not before.

Design phase repeatedly produced things needing rework: authored SplitView stories for 3 compositions then collapsed to 1 unified story (2 commits rework); extracted KPI/Sparkline stories then re-bound to composition in T4/T5 (consumer wiring not planned); designed 6x3 Kind-Representation matrix then retracted when founder said 'Representations don't exist at runtime'; designed per-surface split implementations then unified in T6 (didn't ask 'are these the same split?' before designing variants). Root: no extract-before-invent validation at design time; invent first, extract second.

Designer falsely claimed authored stories: commit messages like 'concept+design(AM5): author KPI + Sparkline stories' implied these were locked-concept stories, but were actually design-time extractions discovered when iterating the model. Created timeline confusion ('locked at concept time vs extracted in Phase 2?'). Root: concept lock wasn't an explicit gate; design and concept iterated together.

Diff-core was built-but-unwired: T2 committed diff-core as standalone DS component with snapshot stories. T9 (7 commits later, before review) wired it into review page via getDiffRenderer selector. Code review Round 1 caught: 'K2b diff-core unwired + red lint' (commit 88ef8ff3). Fixed in 9b6db8d7. Root: architecture plan didn't enumerate consumer story for diff-core primitive; wiring was implicit ('review will use it') not explicit. Snapshot tests were green; integration test delayed until consumer refactored.

Viewer-worktree mismatch during build: live viewer served stale main-checkout files for a stretch, slowing feedback on design changes (Hearth layering, SplitView refinements) and requiring manual fixes. Root: worktree lifecycle management (known pattern CC-005). Early iterations to Hearth model would have caught feedback earlier.

Pre-build cycle unusually long (20/50 commits = 40% of total) due to unlocked concept and founder-loop model iteration. No escalation risk (model converged cleanly), but signal for next primitive-introducing workpackage: concept must be locked explicitly before design phase begins, not iterated in-flight.
